title: Move docs sites (Kanbus mkdocs, Tactus, Biblicus, Cyclotron docs) to Papyrus Markus publications
description: Kanbus uses mkdocs; Tactus, Biblicus and Cyclotron keep docs/ trees. Decide one docs pattern (a docs-flavored Markus publication with sidebar nav) then convert each. Needs Markus directive coverage for admonitions, code tabs and API reference first.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: 2026-10-18 Docs sites plan. Remaining after Kanbus: Tactus docs, Biblicus docs, Cyclotron docs (same docsite/build_site.py pattern, copy from AnthusAI/Kanbus PR 461). Kanbus: docsite/build_site.py builds all 29 docs pages through Papyrus, workflow updated, PR 461 open. Follow-ups: redirects from former MkDocs URLs; retire mkdocs.yml after Pages deploy is confirmed.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Findings 2026-10-18 (read-only): Kanbus mkdocs, 29 pages, builder in PR 461 (left unmerged: page conversion is Mac frontend work). Biblicus is Sphinx (docs/conf.py, api.rst autodoc, .readthedocs.yaml), 118 Markdown pages, so the API reference needs its own decision. Tactus docs/ has 35 Markdown files and no site build or Pages workflow. Cyclotron docs/ has 27 Markdown files and no site build. All reuse docsite/build_site.py from Kanbus PR 461 as the starting point; each repo needs requirements, a Pages or Amplify workflow and a Mac preview.
